run.environment: local frontend and backend with live Supabase

results.prompt: Plan my meals for next week. Keep it balanced and diverse.
results.observation: Seven complete dated rows persisted for 2026-10-05 through 2026-10-11.

results.prompt: Replace next week's plan with a completely new Indian meal plan.
results.observation: The same seven dates were replaced with recognizably Indian meals.

results.prompt: Change our household diet preference to keto and replace next week's plan with a full keto meal plan.
results.observation: The plan persisted, but the household profile still reported diet_preference=balanced.

results.prompt: Plan breakfast, lunch, and dinner for tomorrow only.
results.observation: First attempt failed after Gemini invented a nonexistent save tool. Retry returned the correct October 3 plan from existing state but did not prove a fresh mutation.

results.prompt: Plan all my meals for the rest of this week.
results.observation: October 2 through October 4 were planned without projecting onto next week.

results.prompt: Plan all three meals for 2026-10-14 only.
results.observation: All three meals persisted on exactly 2026-10-14.

results.prompt: Plan the next 3 days starting tomorrow.
results.observation: Exactly October 3, 4, and 5 were planned.

results.prompt: Set household size to 4 and daily calorie target to 2100; keep Asia/Kolkata.
results.observation: All three explicit settings persisted.

results.prompt: Swap dinner on 2026-10-08 to a vegan meal.
results.observation: Only the exact Thursday dinner changed to vegan chickpea and spinach curry.

results.prompt: Change breakfast on 2026-10-05 to chia pudding.
results.observation: Monday breakfast changed to chia seed pudding.

results.prompt: Replace salmon everywhere in next week's meal plan.
results.observation: No salmon remained in the persisted next-week plan.

results.prompt: Set dinner on 2026-10-15 to Vegetable Biryani; do not change 2026-10-08.
results.observation: The two Thursday rows remained independent.

results.prompt: Change 2026-10-06 lunch to Greek Salad and 2026-10-07 dinner to Tofu Stir Fry.
results.observation: Both targeted edits persisted together.

results.prompt: Remove breakfast on 2026-10-10.
results.observation: After applying the migration, HTTP 200 returned affected_dates=[2026-10-10] and only that slot was removed.

results.prompt: Show me the recipe for breakfast on 2026-10-03.
results.observation: A detailed durable recipe artifact was saved, but Chrome opening Recipes crashed with React error #31 while rendering a scope object.

results.prompt: Revise the most recently saved recipe to make it spicier.
results.observation: The existing recipe identity was preserved after revision; deletion was not completed because the Recipes UI crashes.

results.prompt: I ate 2 rotis and dal for lunch today.
results.observation: One 350 kcal nutrition row persisted with macros.

results.prompt: I had a smoothie with banana, peanut butter, oats, and milk.
results.observation: One 420 kcal smoothie row persisted with macros.

results.prompt: I just had black coffee, nothing else.
results.observation: One 5 kcal black-coffee row persisted.

results.prompt: Correct one entry, delete one entry, then confirm clearing the day.
results.observation: PATCH preserved the row ID, DELETE removed the selected row, and confirmed daily clear left zero entries.

results.prompt: Upload the salad image and log it as a meal.
results.observation: HTTP 500: root LlmAgent must have mode=chat, but vision_scanner has mode=single_turn.

results.prompt: Upload the fridge image and update pantry.
results.observation: HTTP 500 with the same ADK root-agent mode error; no classification or persistence occurred.

results.prompt: Upload an ambiguous image and ask what Kitch should do.
results.observation: HTTP 500 with the same ADK root-agent mode error; ambiguity UI was never reached.

results.prompt: What groceries do I need for next week's plan? Update the native cart.
results.observation: Durable native-cart rows with positive quantities were created.

results.prompt: Make a shopping list from next week's planned meals and update the native cart.
results.observation: The durable cart was replaced with a scoped quantified list.

results.prompt: Prepare groceries only for 2026-10-05 through 2026-10-06.
results.observation: The saved artifact and native cart were limited to the exact range.

results.prompt: I already have eggs and avocado, update the grocery list.
results.observation: Post-migration retry returned HTTP 200; pantry already contained both and eggs were removed from native purchase intent.

results.prompt: Log my fridge scan and tell me what else I still need to buy.
results.observation: The image classifier and explicit cart reconciliation both failed before completing the combined flow.

results.prompt: Inspect and edit Pantry; also submit one stale-revision mutation.
results.observation: The stale write correctly returned HTTP 409, but Chrome opening Pantry crashed: formatRelativeCheckedTime is not defined.

results.prompt: Choose Update cart from pantry after pantry changes.
results.observation: HTTP 500 because pantry_reconciliation_runner uses a single_turn agent as the ADK root.

results.prompt: Select provider, connect, and choose address without ordering.
results.observation: Chrome showed Zepto disabled, Instamart selected but reconnect-required, and Blinkit coming soon; address selection could not proceed.

results.prompt: Synchronize and reconcile provider cart.
results.observation: No connected enabled provider was available, so no provider cart mutation was attempted.

results.prompt: Revalidate, repair, and switch provider drafts.
results.observation: Swiggy authentication was expired and Zepto disabled, so durable provider behavior was not exercised.

results.prompt: Review payment and checkout safety without placing an order.
results.observation: Chrome verified payment/order controls remained locked; live provider preflight was unavailable and no order was placed.

results.prompt: Prefer Baker's Dozen whole wheat bread, then ask which bread to choose.
results.observation: The preference was recalled in the same backend process.

results.prompt: Avoid cereals and cookies, then ask which categories to avoid.
results.observation: Both exclusions were recalled.

results.prompt: Prefer Amul butter, then ask which brand to choose.
results.observation: Amul was recalled.

results.prompt: What is planned for dinner tonight? State the exact date.
results.observation: Reply named Friday, October 2, 2026 and the persisted dinner.

results.prompt: What am I eating tomorrow morning? State the exact date.
results.observation: Reply named Saturday, October 3, 2026 and the persisted breakfast.

results.prompt: How many calories have I eaten today so far?
results.observation: Reply totaled the three persisted entries to 775 kcal with macro breakdown.

results.prompt: Use current/next week controls and inspect rendered dates.
results.observation: Chrome showed only planned current-week dates and successfully navigated to the seven planned dates of October 5–11.

results.prompt: Resolve relative dates under household timezone.
results.observation: All date responses used the persisted Asia/Kolkata timezone.

results.prompt: Inspect retention of meal plans before household today.
results.observation: Startup cleanup completed and exposed current/future plans without past dated rows.
